Won't Google detect and deprioritize my AI-generated articles?

It is the most common worry about AI content, so here is the honest answer: no SEO, human or AI, can promise you rankings, and any tool that claims otherwise is bluffing. What the evidence does show is that Google does not penalize content for being AI-written. It penalizes thin, mass-produced pages built to game rankings, which is a different thing entirely. Four points worth seeing for yourself:

  • Google says so itself. Its official guidance is about "rewarding high-quality content, however it is produced," and using AI is explicitly not against the rules. What breaks the rules is content made to manipulate rankings instead of helping readers. (Google Search Central)
  • The spam policy targets intent, not authorship. Google acts on mass-produced pages made to game search "no matter how they are created." Its yardstick is quality and intent, not whether a person or an agent did the drafting. (Google spam policies)
  • The data backs it up. Ahrefs analyzed roughly 600,000 pages and found effectively zero correlation (0.011) between how AI-written a page is and where it ranks. 86.5% of top-ranking pages already use AI to some degree. (Ahrefs)
  • The detectors do not even work. In 2023 OpenAI shut down its own AI-text detector for a "low rate of accuracy." It caught AI writing only 26% of the time, so the idea that AI content gets reliably flagged does not hold up. (TechCrunch)

Bonus: the same logic carries into AI search. ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews mostly cite pages that already rank in Google's top 10, so ranking well and getting quoted by AI are the same game, not competing ones. No content, human or AI, is ever guaranteed to rank; that is just how search works. What Zaatar can do is build for the right side of that line: genuinely useful, well-structured pages, not thin mass-produced ones, with you in the approval seat on everything it ships. (Ahrefs)

Do I need a ChatGPT or Claude subscription, or my own API key, to use Zaatar?

No. Zaatar comes with everything the agents need built in. The AI runs on our side, so you never bring your own subscription or API key, and there is nothing extra to pay for or wire up. The price you see is all in.

What does "autonomous" actually mean?

The agents work on their own schedule, like a team that never clocks out. They audit your site, prepare the technical fixes, write article drafts, improve page titles and structure, and keep watch on your rankings and performance. The key part: anything that would change your live site is only prepared, never applied. It all lands in a review queue where you approve each change with one click, and Zaatar never publishes anything on its own. Nothing ships without your call.

Will the agents write content that sounds like AI slop?

Drafts are written from an SEO brief with target keywords, search intent, and audience baked in, so the article is structured to rank from the first paragraph. Every draft then passes through a quality-gate agent that explicitly scores "signs of AI writing": em dashes, banned filler like delve, leverage, or robust, and empty openers like Furthermore hard-cap the score and block the draft from moving on. What survives lands in your editor for a final pass. Nothing publishes until you sign off. The OS biases toward fewer, longer, more useful pieces over high-volume mediocrity.

How fast is setup?

Super fast. You just need to connect your Search Console and your GitHub repository. Then you watch as Zaatar audits your site, drafts a todo list based on what needs the most work, and lets the agents take it from there. CMS connections (Webflow, WordPress, Shopify) are coming soon.

How long until I see results?

Technical fixes (Core Web Vitals, schema, internal links) land in PRs within the first week and typically start moving rankings 2-4 weeks after Google recrawls. Content compounds slower: expect 2-3 months of consistent shipping before a pillar starts ranking. Zaatar tracks your rankings daily, so you watch the curve, not just the destination.

Do I need a GitHub repo?

During the Beta, yes. GitHub is how the work ships today: schema, internal links, meta tags, Core Web Vitals fixes, and content as Markdown/MDX all arrive as draft pull requests, so the optimization runs end to end with you on the merge button. CMS connections (Webflow, WordPress, Shopify) are coming soon: on a CMS, Zaatar can't touch the underlying code, so it will produce the same work as artifacts ready to apply - optimized titles and meta descriptions, schema markup ready to paste, internal-link recommendations, and content drafts.

Which tech stacks does Zaatar work with?

Any stack that lives in a Git repository: Next.js, Astro, plain HTML, documentation sites, custom frameworks. The agents audit your live site, so the framework does not matter, and fixes and content ship as pull requests against your repo. Support for CMS-hosted sites (Webflow, WordPress, Shopify) is coming soon.

Does it work on non-English sites?

Yes. Agents read and write in the language of your content. Multi-locale sites with hreflang are handled per locale, with signals reconciled separately for each surface so a French page is not graded against an English one.

Can I have multiple websites managed by Zaatar? Do I get a discount?

Yes. Each website runs as its own workspace on its own plan, and every website you add after the first is discounted: if the new website is on the same plan as one you already run, you get 15% off that plan's price for the new website. If it is on a different plan, the 15% comes off the cheaper of the two plans. During the Beta accounts start with a single website; multi-website switches on right after.

What does it cost?

Plans start at $79 / month and scale with your pages and languages - the full breakdown is in the pricing section above. During the Beta we are onboarding 3 "design partners" companies before opening the product to the public.

Get early access
What happens to my work if I cancel?

Everything the agents shipped is yours. Merged PRs, published drafts, and schema patches stay live on your site because they live in your repo, not ours. Cancel and the workspace freezes; your strategy doc and historical data export on request.

blocks.html_en: It is the most common worry about AI content, so here is the honest answer: no SEO, human or AI, can promise you rankings, and any tool that claims otherwise is bluffing. What the evidence does show is that Google does not penalize content for being AI-written. It penalizes thin, mass-produced pages built to game rankings, which is a different thing entirely. Four points worth seeing for yourself:

sentences.en: It is the most common worry about AI content, so here is the honest answer: no SEO, human or AI, can promise you rankings, and any tool that claims otherwise is bluffing.
sentences.zh: 这是对人工智能内容最常见的担忧，所以这里是诚实的答案：没有任何 SEO，无论是人类还是人工智能，都可以向你保证排名，任何声称不这样做的工具都是在虚张声势。

sentences.en: What the evidence does show is that Google does not penalize content for being AI-written.
sentences.zh: 证据确实表明，谷歌不会惩罚人工智能编写的内容。

sentences.en: It penalizes thin, mass-produced pages built to game rankings, which is a different thing entirely.
sentences.zh: 它会惩罚为游戏排名而构建的薄的、批量生产的页面，这完全是另一回事。

sentences.en: Four points worth seeing for yourself:

blocks.html_en: • Google says so itself. Its official guidance is about "rewarding high-quality content, however it is produced," and using AI is explicitly not against the rules. What breaks the rules is content made to manipulate rankings instead of helping readers. (Google Search Central)

sentences.zh: 谷歌自己也是这么说的。

sentences.en: Its official guidance is about "rewarding high-quality content, however it is produced," and using AI is explicitly not against the rules.
sentences.zh: 其官方指导方针是“奖励高质量内容，无论其制作方式如何”，并且使用人工智能显然并不违反规则。

sentences.en: What breaks the rules is content made to manipulate rankings instead of helping readers.
sentences.zh: 违反规则的是内容是为了操纵排名而不是帮助读者。

blocks.html_en: • The spam policy targets intent, not authorship. Google acts on mass-produced pages made to game search "no matter how they are created." Its yardstick is quality and intent, not whether a person or an agent did the drafting. (Google spam policies)

sentences.en: The spam policy targets intent, not authorship.
sentences.zh: 垃圾邮件政策针对的是意图，而不是作者。

sentences.en: Google acts on mass-produced pages made to game search "no matter how they are created."
sentences.zh: 谷歌对为游戏搜索而制作的批量生产的页面起作用，“无论它们是如何创建的”。

sentences.en: Its yardstick is quality and intent, not whether a person or an agent did the drafting.
sentences.zh: 它的衡量标准是质量和意图，而不是起草者是个人还是代理人。

blocks.html_en: • The data backs it up. Ahrefs analyzed roughly 600,000 pages and found effectively zero correlation (0.011) between how AI-written a page is and where it ranks. 86.5% of top-ranking pages already use AI to some degree. (Ahrefs)

sentences.en: Ahrefs analyzed roughly 600,000 pages and found effectively zero correlation (0.011) between how AI-written a page is and where it ranks.
sentences.zh: Ahrefs 分析了大约 600,000 个页面，发现人工智能编写页面的方式与其排名之间的相关性实际上为零 (0.011)。

sentences.en: 86.5% of top-ranking pages already use AI to some degree.
sentences.zh: 86.5% 的顶级页面已经在一定程度上使用了人工智能。

blocks.html_en: • The detectors do not even work. In 2023 OpenAI shut down its own AI-text detector for a "low rate of accuracy." It caught AI writing only 26% of the time, so the idea that AI content gets reliably flagged does not hold up. (TechCrunch)

sentences.en: The detectors do not even work.
In 2023 OpenAI shut down its own AI-text detector for a "low rate of accuracy."
sentences.zh: 2023 年，OpenAI 因“准确率低”而关闭了自己的人工智能文本检测器。

sentences.en: It caught AI writing only 26% of the time, so the idea that AI content gets reliably flagged does not hold up.
sentences.zh: 它仅在 26% 的时间内捕获 AI 写入，因此 AI 内容得到可靠标记的想法并不成立。

blocks.html_en: Bonus: the same logic carries into AI search. ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews mostly cite pages that already rank in Google's top 10, so ranking well and getting quoted by AI are the same game, not competing ones. No content, human or AI, is ever guaranteed to rank; that is just how search works. What Zaatar can do is build for the right side of that line: genuinely useful, well-structured pages, not thin mass-produced ones, with you in the approval seat on everything it ships. (Ahrefs)

sentences.en: Bonus: the same logic carries into AI search.
sentences.zh: 奖励：同样的逻辑也适用于人工智能搜索。

sentences.en: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews mostly cite pages that already rank in Google's top 10, so ranking well and getting quoted by AI are the same game, not competing ones.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Google 的 AI Overviews 大多引用已经排在 Google 前 10 名的页面，因此排名好的和被 AI 引用是同一个游戏，而不是竞争的游戏。

sentences.en: No content, human or AI, is ever guaranteed to rank; that is just how search works.
sentences.zh: 任何内容，无论是人类的还是人工智能的，都不能保证排名；这就是搜索的工作原理。

sentences.en: What Zaatar can do is build for the right side of that line: genuinely useful, well-structured pages, not thin mass-produced ones, with you in the approval seat on everything it ships.
sentences.zh: Zaatar 能做的是针对这条线的右侧进行构建：真正有用、结构良好的页面，而不是薄薄的批量生产的页面，并且您在其发布的所有内容上都有批准权。

blocks.html_en: The agents work on their own schedule, like a team that never clocks out. They audit your site, prepare the technical fixes, write article drafts, improve page titles and structure, and keep watch on your rankings and performance. The key part: anything that would change your live site is only prepared, never applied. It all lands in a review queue where you approve each change with one click, and Zaatar never publishes anything on its own. Nothing ships without your call.

sentences.en: The agents work on their own schedule, like a team that never clocks out.
sentences.zh: 特工们按照自己的时间表工作，就像一个从不下班的团队。

sentences.en: They audit your site, prepare the technical fixes, write article drafts, improve page titles and structure, and keep watch on your rankings and performance.
sentences.zh: 他们审核您的网站，准备技术修复，撰写文章草稿，改进页面标题和结构，并密切关注您的排名和表现。

sentences.en: The key part: anything that would change your live site is only prepared, never applied.
sentences.zh: 关键部分：任何会改变您的实时网站的事情都只是准备好的，而不是应用的。

sentences.en: It all lands in a review queue where you approve each change with one click, and Zaatar never publishes anything on its own.
sentences.zh: 所有内容都会进入审核队列，您只需单击一下即可批准每项更改，而 Zaatar 绝不会自行发布任何内容。
没有您的电话，什么都不会发货。

blocks.html_en: Drafts are written from an SEO brief with target keywords, search intent, and audience baked in, so the article is structured to rank from the first paragraph. Every draft then passes through a quality-gate agent that explicitly scores "signs of AI writing": em dashes, banned filler like delve, leverage, or robust, and empty openers like Furthermore hard-cap the score and block the draft from moving on. What survives lands in your editor for a final pass. Nothing publishes until you sign off. The OS biases toward fewer, longer, more useful pieces over high-volume mediocrity.

sentences.en: Drafts are written from an SEO brief with target keywords, search intent, and audience baked in, so the article is structured to rank from the first paragraph.
sentences.zh: 草稿是根据 SEO 简介编写的，其中包含目标关键词、搜索意图和受众，因此文章的结构是从第一段开始排名。

sentences.en: Every draft then passes through a quality-gate agent that explicitly scores "signs of AI writing": em dashes, banned filler like delve, leverage, or robust, and empty openers like Furthermore hard-cap the score and block the draft from moving on.
sentences.zh: 然后，每份草稿都会经过一个质量门代理，该代理明确地对“人工智能写作的迹象”进行评分：破折号、禁止的填充物（如钻探、杠杆或鲁棒）以及空洞的开场白（如此外），对分数进行硬性限制并阻止草稿继续前进。

sentences.en: What survives lands in your editor for a final pass.
sentences.zh: 幸存下来的内容会落在你的编辑器中进行最后的处理。

sentences.en: Nothing publishes until you sign off.
sentences.zh: 在您签字之前，不会发布任何内容。

sentences.en: The OS biases toward fewer, longer, more useful pieces over high-volume mediocrity.
sentences.zh: 操作系统偏向于更少、更长、更有用的片段，而不是大量的平庸片段。

sentences.zh: 内容复合速度较慢：预计在支柱开始排名之前需要 2-3 个月的持续交付。

sentences.zh: Zaatar 每天都会跟踪您的排名，因此您可以关注曲线，而不仅仅是目的地。

CMS connections (Webflow, WordPress, Shopify) are coming soon: on a CMS, Zaatar can't touch the underlying code, so it will produce the same work as artifacts ready to apply - optimized titles and meta descriptions, schema markup ready to paste, internal-link recommendations, and content drafts.

Won't Google detect and deprioritize my AI-generated articles?

这是对人工智能内容最常见的担忧，所以这里是诚实的答案：没有任何 SEO，无论是人类还是人工智能，都可以向你保证排名，任何声称不这样做的工具都是在虚张声势。 证据确实表明，谷歌不会惩罚人工智能编写的内容。 它会惩罚为游戏排名而构建的薄的、批量生产的页面，这完全是另一回事。 有四点值得你自己看：

  • 谷歌自己也是这么说的。 其官方指导方针是“奖励高质量内容，无论其制作方式如何”，并且使用人工智能显然并不违反规则。 违反规则的是内容是为了操纵排名而不是帮助读者。 （谷歌搜索中心）
  • 垃圾邮件政策针对的是意图，而不是作者。 谷歌对为游戏搜索而制作的批量生产的页面起作用，“无论它们是如何创建的”。 它的衡量标准是质量和意图，而不是起草者是个人还是代理人。 （Google 垃圾邮件政策）
  • 数据支持了这一点。 Ahrefs 分析了大约 600,000 个页面，发现人工智能编写页面的方式与其排名之间的相关性实际上为零 (0.011)。 86.5% 的顶级页面已经在一定程度上使用了人工智能。 （阿雷夫斯）
  • 探测器甚至不工作。 2023 年，OpenAI 因“准确率低”而关闭了自己的人工智能文本检测器。 它仅在 26% 的时间内捕获 AI 写入，因此 AI 内容得到可靠标记的想法并不成立。 （TechCrunch）

奖励：同样的逻辑也适用于人工智能搜索。 ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Google 的 AI Overviews 大多引用已经排在 Google 前 10 名的页面，因此排名好的和被 AI 引用是同一个游戏，而不是竞争的游戏。 任何内容，无论是人类的还是人工智能的，都不能保证排名；这就是搜索的工作原理。 Zaatar 能做的是针对这条线的右侧进行构建：真正有用、结构良好的页面，而不是薄薄的批量生产的页面，并且您在其发布的所有内容上都有批准权。 （阿雷夫斯）

Do I need a ChatGPT or Claude subscription, or my own API key, to use Zaatar?

不会。Zaatar 内置了代理所需的一切。 人工智能在我们这边运行，因此您无需携带自己的订阅或 API 密钥，也无需支付任何额外费用或进行连接。 你看到的价格都在里面了。

What does "autonomous" actually mean?

特工们按照自己的时间表工作，就像一个从不下班的团队。 他们审核您的网站，准备技术修复，撰写文章草稿，改进页面标题和结构，并密切关注您的排名和表现。 关键部分：任何会改变您的实时网站的事情都只是准备好的，而不是应用的。 所有内容都会进入审核队列，您只需单击一下即可批准每项更改，而 Zaatar 绝不会自行发布任何内容。 没有您的电话，什么都不会发货。

Will the agents write content that sounds like AI slop?

草稿是根据 SEO 简介编写的，其中包含目标关键词、搜索意图和受众，因此文章的结构是从第一段开始排名。 然后，每份草稿都会经过一个质量门代理，该代理明确地对“人工智能写作的迹象”进行评分：破折号、禁止的填充物（如钻探、杠杆或鲁棒）以及空洞的开场白（如此外），对分数进行硬性限制并阻止草稿继续前进。 幸存下来的内容会落在你的编辑器中进行最后的处理。 在您签字之前，不会发布任何内容。 操作系统偏向于更少、更长、更有用的片段，而不是大量的平庸片段。

How fast is setup?

超级快。 您只需连接 Search Console 和 GitHub 存储库即可。 然后，您会看到 Zaatar 审核您的网站，根据最需要做的工作起草一份待办事项列表，然后让代理从那里处理。 CMS 连接（Webflow、WordPress、Shopify）即将推出。

How long until I see results?

技术修复（核心网络生命、架构、内部链接）会在第一周内出现在 PR 中，并且通常会在 Google 重新抓取后 2-4 周开始改变排名。 内容复合速度较慢：预计在支柱开始排名之前需要 2-3 个月的持续交付。 Zaatar 每天都会跟踪您的排名，因此您可以关注曲线，而不仅仅是目的地。

Do I need a GitHub repo?

在测试期间，是的。 GitHub 是当今作品的发布方式：架构、内部链接、元标记、Core Web Vitals 修复以及 Markdown/MDX 内容都以草稿拉取请求的形式到达，因此优化会在您点击合并按钮时端到端运行。 CMS 连接（Webflow、WordPress、Shopify）即将推出：在 CMS 上，Zaatar 无法触及底层代码，因此它将生成与准备应用的工件相同的工作 - 优化的标题和元描述、准备粘贴的模式标记、内部链接推荐和内容草稿。

Which tech stacks does Zaatar work with?

Git 存储库中的任何堆栈：Next.js、Astro、纯 HTML、文档站点、自定义框架。 代理会审核您的实时站点，因此框架并不重要，并且修复和内容会作为针对您的存储库的拉取请求来发送。 对 CMS 托管网站（Webflow、WordPress、Shopify）的支持即将推出。

Does it work on non-English sites?

是的。 代理以您内容的语言进行阅读和写作。 具有 hreflang 的多语言环境网站按语言环境进行处理，并针对每个表面单独协调信号，因此法语页面不会根据英语页面进行评分。

Can I have multiple websites managed by Zaatar? Do I get a discount?

是的。 每个网站都按照自己的计划作为自己的工作区运行，并且您在第一个网站之后添加的每个网站都会打折：如果新网站与您已经运行的网站采用相同的计划，则新网站的计划价格可享受 15% 的折扣。 如果是不同的计划，则 15% 是两个计划中较便宜的一个。 在测试版期间，帐户从一个网站开始；多网站立即开启。
